cases.customer_question: Can a Link Layer supporting AoA/AoD be combined with an RF PHY QDID that does not support AoA/AoD?
question_variants: Can AoA/AoD-capable Link Layer reuse a non-AoA RF PHY QDID?
Why does AoA/AoD mismatch cause IDL errors?
Can TCW waive AoA/AoD inter-layer inconsistencies?
Is a mixed AoA/AoD QDID combination allowed?
How do I resolve AoA/AoD RF PHY compatibility errors?
cases.actual_issue: A Bluetooth qualification design attempted to combine a Link Layer QDID supporting AoA/AoD with an RF PHY QDID lacking AoA/AoD support, causing fatal inter-layer dependency inconsistencies that could not be waived using TCW.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth layers must agree on supported features. If the Link Layer claims advanced direction-finding features like AoA/AoD, the RF PHY layer must also support the related requirements. When the feature support does not match, the qualification system detects incompatibilities and blocks the design combination.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that the selected Link Layer supported AoA/AoD while the referenced RF PHY qualification did not. This mismatch generated multiple fatal IDL errors between RF PHY and LL capabilities. The consultant explicitly stated that these inconsistencies were not eligible for resolution through TCW. As a workaround, the consultant recommended using a prepared subset Design Number that excluded AoA/AoD and Class 1 support, allowing the combination to pass without the fatal IDL inconsistencies and enabling qualification with TCW.
cases.decision_logic: AoA/AoD capabilities must remain consistent across dependent Bluetooth layers. TCW cannot be used to waive prohibited inter-layer dependency mismatches involving incompatible RF PHY and Link Layer feature support.
cases.final_recommendation: Use a subset DN that removes unsupported AoA/AoD and incompatible features before combining the RF PHY and Link Layer designs. Validate inter-layer dependency consistency before qualification submission.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Using incompatible AoA/AoD feature combinations can make the design unqualifiable and force redesign or re-selection of QDIDs late in the qualification process.
